g1|variants|down payments.summary: This family covers standard SAP S/4HANA OTC down payment processing variants driven by SD billing plans and FI integration. The variants differ by whether down payments are requested via billing requests, cleared against final invoices automatically or manually, and handled with standard or advanced payment integration.

variants.when_used: Used when an upfront payment is required from the customer before goods delivery, controlled via a milestone billing plan in the sales order.

variants.name: Mandatory Down Payment with Delivery Block

g1|panel|down payments.otc_impact: Down payments sit between Order-to-Cash and Financial Accounting by securing customer capital before fulfilling sales orders and deliveries. This process changes sales order creation by introducing billing plans and delivery blocks, ensures correct accounts receivable posting via special G/L indicators, and automates clearing when final billing documents are generated. It protects cash flow and minimizes credit risk for engineered-to-order and high-value capital goods transactions.

panel_qa.question: How do we ensure that outbound deliveries remain strictly blocked until the customer's down payment is fully cleared in Finance?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: This requirement is met by assigning a billing plan type that triggers down payment requests and setting a delivery block at the sales document header level via transaction VOR1 or customizing path Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Credit Management/Risk Management. When the financial posting clears the down payment request in transaction F-29 or FBR1, a payment status update removes the delivery block automatically through standard credit management or event-driven process chains. This guarantees that physical warehouse picking and goods issue never occur without prior financial commitment. The leadership value is eliminated bad debt risk and strict adherence to company credit policy before inventory leaves the warehouse. Next, we should review the automated clearing rules in FI-AR. Trap: We can just trust the sales team to remove the delivery block manually once the customer says they paid.
panel_qa.trap: We can just trust the sales team to remove the delivery block manually once the customer says they paid.

panel_qa.question: Why use a billing plan instead of a manual SD billing document for generating down payment requests?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Billing plans automate the schedule of down payment requests based on dates or milestones defined in customizing path Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Plan. Using billing plan types linked to item categories ensures that standard SD billing transaction VF01 generates billing document requests with specific billing types such as FAZ for down payments and FAZ2 for final settlement. This standard approach maintains absolute document traceability from the sales order item to the accounting document, avoiding manual data entry errors. The technical configuration relies on requirement classes and billing relevance setting 'E' for billing plan on the item category. Next, we will configure the milestone percentages for project-based orders. Trap: Manual billing documents are faster to set up because we do not need to configure billing plan types.
panel_qa.trap: Manual billing documents are faster to set up because we do not need to configure billing plan types.

panel_qa.question: How does the final billing document correctly offset the down payment already paid without creating duplicate revenue recognition?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: The system offsets the down payment through statistical billing items and special G/L integration in pricing procedure RVAA01 using condition types such as AZWR for down payment clearing. When creating the final invoice in transaction VF01, the billing type F2 automatically pulls open down payment items referenced from the preceding billing plan or sales order. Accounting document posting clears the special G/L account (target reconciliation account) and posts net revenue to the standard revenue account. This ensures compliance with IFRS 15 regarding contract liabilities and prevents inflated revenue reporting. Next, we will audit the condition exclusion groups for down payment clearing types. Trap: We should post the down payment as a standard credit memo to reduce the final invoice value.
panel_qa.trap: We should post the down payment as a standard credit memo to reduce the final invoice value.

g1|core|down payments|standard down paym.title: Standard Down Payment Request with Billing Plan
g1|core|down payments|standard down paym.story: Imagine a customer promises to pay for a big custom treehouse before we even start cutting the wood, so we send them a formal note asking for their advance deposit before any boxes are packed. More precisely, this scenario uses a milestone billing plan assigned to the sales order item to generate a Down Payment Request (billing type FA) which posts to Financial Accounting using Special G/L indicator A, before the normal delivery and shipping cycle continues.
g1|core|down payments|standard down paym.why_business_needs_it: Sellers use down payments to secure working capital and reduce credit risk before committing inventory and warehouse labor to custom or high-value sales orders. In SAP OTC, linking a billing plan to the sales document automates the generation of down payment requests without requiring manual financial entries.

modules.role: Configures sales document types, billing plan types, item categories, and triggers the creation of down payment requests.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for posting the down payment request and later clearing the advance against the final invoice.

modules.role: Receives the billing document, posts the open item against the customer using Special G/L indicator A, and manages incoming payments.
modules.hands_off_to: SD (Sales and Distribution) to release billing blocks or allow delivery creation once payment is cleared.

g1|core|down payments|mandatory down pay.title: Mandatory Down Payment with Delivery Block for Sales Orders
g1|core|down payments|mandatory down pay.story: Just like putting down cash before a baker starts baking your custom cake, this process makes customers pay upfront before the warehouse is allowed to ship their goods. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, the sales order creates a milestone billing plan which triggers a down payment request, while automatically locking the delivery until the customer pays and clears the financial debt.
g1|core|down payments|mandatory down pay.why_business_needs_it: This process shields the business from credit defaults and bad debt by ensuring customers fund a mandatory portion of high-value or custom orders before physical inventory leaves the plant. It enforces financial compliance by blocking fulfillment until the accounting department clears the incoming down payment against a special General Ledger indicator.

modules.role: Controls sales order creation, milestone billing plan generation, item categories, pricing, and automated delivery blocks.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for billing plan down payment request generation and special G/L clearing postings.

modules.role: Manages customer accounts, special G/L indicator posting, down payment requests, clearing documents, and incoming payments.
modules.hands_off_to: SD (Sales and Distribution) to release the delivery block once the payment is posted.

prerequisites: Customer Master Data with company code and sales area data assigned -- XD01
Material Master Data with sales organization and general plant data maintained -- MM01
Pricing Procedure containing down payment condition types -- V/08
FI Special G/L account set up for customer down payments -- FS00

Click the New Entries button on the application toolbar
Type 2 in the Billing Plan Type field
Type Milestone Billing in the Description field
Type MILE in the Date category field
Type 1 in the Calculation rule field
Click the Save button and assign the transport request

run_steps.result: Creates Sales Order OR with delivery block Z1 and an active milestone billing plan generating a down payment request.

run_steps.step: Create Down Payment Request Billing Document
run_steps.result: Generates billing document FA (Down Payment Request) and posts the preliminary request to FI accounting.

run_steps.step: Post Customer Down Payment Against Request
run_steps.transaction: F-29 (Fiori: Post Customer Down Payment - F-29)
run_steps.result: Posts incoming payment with Special G/L Indicator A, reducing the customer's liability and clearing the request.

run_steps.step: Remove Delivery Block from Sales Order
run_steps.result: Removes delivery block Z1 from the sales order header once financial clearance is verified.
Creates outbound delivery document for shipment processing from the unblocked sales order.
Updates inventory quantities and posts Goods Issue (GI) in warehouse.
Generates final invoice F2, offsetting the down payment clearing line item against the total invoice value.
